# Benjamin Moore

> > Premium paint and colour innovation company offering interior and exterior paints, stains, and professional colour consulting services.

Benjamin Moore, a Berkshire Hathaway company headquartered in Montvale, NJ, is a leading paint manufacturer known for Gennex Colour Technology, historical colour collections, and annual Colour of the Year selections. The company serves homeowners, contractors, and designers across North America and 77+ countries through independent retailers and international distributors.

## Key Topics

- Gennex Colour Technology
- Colour of the Year
- CENTURY product line
- Soft Touch Matte finish
- Historical Collection
- Interior and exterior paints
- Colour palettes and trends
- Contractor products
- Designer tools (Color Portfolio App, ColorReader)
- Independent paint retailers
- Premium paint chemistry
- International distribution
- Colour psychology
- Paint troubleshooting

## Products & Technology

- [Quality Begins with Chemistry | Benjamin Moore](https://www.benjaminmoore.com/en-ca/interior-exterior-paints-stains/quality-begins-with-chemistry): Paint chemistry & innovation with Gennex technology and Eco Spec products
- [Contractor Products | Benjamin Moore](https://www.benjaminmoore.com/en-ca/contractors/products): Complete catalog of contractor-approved paints, primers, stains & coatings
- [CENTURY Colour & Finish Launches in Canada | Benjamin Moore](https://www.benjaminmoore.com/en-ca/press/benjamin-moore-reveals-century): CENTURY product launch in Canada with 75 new colours & Soft Touch Matte finish

## Professional Resources

- [Designers | Benjamin Moore](https://www.benjaminmoore.com/en-ca/designers): Designer resources: Color Portfolio App, ColorReader & professional tools

- [Troubleshooting | Benjamin Moore](https://www.benjaminmoore.com/en-ca/contractors/job-solutions/troubleshooting): Solutions for common painting issues: surfactant leaching, burnishing, blistering

## Colour Collections & Trends

- [Historical Collection | Benjamin Moore](https://www.benjaminmoore.com/en-ca/colour-overview/colour-palettes/historical-collection): Historical Collection: 191 heritage colours celebrating American architecture
- [2018 Colour of the Year: Caliente AF-290 | Benjamin Moore](https://www.benjaminmoore.com/en-ca/press/caliente-2018-colour-of-the-year): 2018 Colour of the Year announcement: Caliente AF-290 vibrant red shade
- [2016 Colour of the Year: Simply White | Benjamin Moore](https://www.benjaminmoore.com/en-ca/press/simply-white-2016-colour-of-the-year): 2016 Colour of the Year: Simply White OC-117 announcement & trends
- [Psychology of Colour | Benjamin Moore](https://www.benjaminmoore.com/en-ca/colour-overview/colour-insights/psychology-of-colour): How colour combinations influence mood and room atmosphere
